english.note: Use 想要 to make the desire more explicit or stronger, especially when wanting a thing, an action, or someone sexually.
Use this for a straightforward statement of wanting or desiring an object or action rather than an offer-question.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 jiu3 ni1 fan6 gung1

examples.english: I would like to buy this book.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 maai5 ni1 bun2 syu1

english.note: Use this when wanting a person in a romantic or sexual context.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 jiu3 nei5
